name: Mark Newcomb
occupation: Teton County commissioner and board chair (serving through December 31, 2026)
prior_offices: Teton County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election; listed as chair on the official commissioners page, term January 1, 2023, through December 31, 2026; lost the 2026 Democratic primary)
background: Mark Newcomb is chair of the Teton County Board of County Commissioners, serving through December 31, 2026. The official commissioners page lists him as chair with a term of January 1, 2023, through December 31, 2026. He won the November 2022 general election and lost the 2026 Democratic primary. Incoming commissioner Ali Dunford takes office in January 2027.
